identity.description: A2A orchestrator: routes a question to the top-2 specialist expert agents, calls them IN PARALLEL over the Blocks network (ctx.taskClient), and merges their cited answers into a single research brief.

inputs.description: A research question about the brain-technology corpus (citations returned as [n])
inputs.example: What are the best EEG motor-imagery decoding methods?

inputs.description: Optional comma-separated specialist agentNames to call in parallel (default: the top-2 topic experts routed from the question)

outputs.description: The agent’s answer, citing corpus papers as [n]
Cited papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)
Per-specialist breakdown as structured JSON (agent, status, answer, sources)

_default.description: Answer text streamed token-by-token as it is generated

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning

tags.name: Research Assistant
tags.description: Answers questions with citations to a 215-paper arXiv corpus

tags.name: A2A Orchestration
tags.description: Calls specialist agents in parallel and merges their results
examples: Compare connectomics and deep learning approaches in brain research
